about: Gold set for the meta-backend classifier (meta/dryrun-backend.mjs reports precision against it; meta/test/backend.test.mjs checks its shape). 49 servers drawn on 28 Nov 2026 from the dry run of the real frame (a stable hash pick: 18 the classifier called local_full, 14 mock_min, 18 none; AnxForever/stylekit was left out, unread). Each was labelled from its README, manifests and tool-registration source, read through the GitHub API (nothing cloned or run), by a second agent that was not shown the classifier's answer. has_write_tools: whether any MCP tool changes state; backend: where those writes go, as a map id, other:<name> for a hosted API no map names, or none. The expected class is derived from these with the maps in force (backendGoldClass), so a map change moves expectations with it. Precision beats recall: routing stays off until precision on local_full and mock_min is at least 90% on this set.
